candidates.text: Bitcoin was never riding on a president. The strategic Bitcoin Reserve still hasn't bought a single coin. And Bitcoin grew into a trillion dollar asset under governments that ignored it or outright fought against it. The thesis is centered around money. A government that owes $40 trillion has to keep making its money worth less, no matter who wins an election.

People are trying to manipulate you. People are trying to manipulate your emotions to make you part with your Bitcoin potentially. I just can't overstate how much like fear and anger cloud your judgment. Myself included, I'm not immune from this. It's been a brutal time to huddle, right? But Bitcoin has a really unique way of like messing with your psychology.

Meanwhile, Bitcoin had a terrible weekend. We went all the way down to 62K, $2 billion in leverage wiped out, $645 million in just 30 minutes. We were just a stone throw away from the 58K gang there, so eat your heart out. And of course, it's putting pressure on everybody. Strategy and metaplan are both making moves while they're down.

Billions of dollars in liquidations, as always, I believe $2 billion on Bitcoin alone just Saturday and Sunday. And further proof that sometimes when market sentiment is generally bad, Bitcoin can really take it on the chin because it's open 24 -7, 365.
